tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Ruparelia red, sampled from the logo swoosh. Primary buttons, links on hover, the swoosh motif, one accent per view. White text on it passes 5.4:1. Never body text on paper at small sizes in dark theme.

tokens.name: red-deep
tokens.usage: Pressed and hover state of red buttons; red text on paper (6.8:1).

tokens.name: maroon
tokens.usage: Heritage maroon, taken from the 'Serving to Grow' group materials. Large dark bands: hero overlays, impact band, footer. Text on it is paper.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: The wordmark black. Headings and body text on paper and surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, meta lines, captions. 6.7:1 on paper.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. Warm off-white so logos on white cards sit forward.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, header, logo tiles. Business logos always sit on this, never on colour.

tokens.name: stone
tokens.usage: Quiet tint for alternating sections, tag fills, table stripes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card borders, dividers, input borders at rest.

tokens.name: on-dark
tokens.usage: Text and rules on maroon, red and ink bands.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: CMS only: Active, Published, Verified (high confidence).

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: CMS only: Pre-opening, Awaiting review, Medium confidence.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: CMS only: Conflicting ownership, Verify, Historical. Always paired with a word, never colour alone.

families.serif: "Libre Caslon Text", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Home hero only, one per page.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: Serving to Grow and Growing to Serve
styles.usage: The group line and pull quotes. Italic echoes 'Group' in the logo.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above headings; red or ink-muted.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label, tag padding block.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside tags and button groups.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Tag padding inline, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Grid gutter on mobile, form gaps.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, grid gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between a heading block and its content.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page side margin on desktop.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, tags. The group reads institutional: corners stay nearly square.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and logo tiles.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status dots and filter chips only.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Card hover only. At rest cards use a line border.
